purpose: Evidence-linked information-panel registry. Every animated (or deliberately non-animated) event has a note that preserves scientific transparency. Badges map each note to its evidence confidence.

badges.SUPPORTED: directly supported by a full-text primary (green)
badges.SUPPORTED_QUALITATIVE: event reported but exact kinetics/timing not given (teal)
badges.OBSERVED_TIMING_UNKNOWN: observed in literature; exact timing not reported (amber)
badges.HYPOTHESIZED: general expectation, not evidenced for this preset (grey)
badges.DO_NOT_ANIMATE: explicitly unsupported; shown as text note only, never animated (red)

panels.note: Topical application supported by Chen 2012.
Skin permeation and depth-layer deposition supported by Chen 2012 (rat abdominal skin; sections 0-30, 30-60, 60-90 um).
Uptake order cationic > neutral > anionic (HaCaT/B16BL6), Chen 2012. Note: charge co-varies with lipid identity - observed association, not an isolated charge effect.
Particle size approximately 85-90 nm (Chen 2012). Sizes are too close to differentiate outcomes; size does not drive the animation.
Sustained/delayed release has been reported, although exact release kinetics were not available (Chen 2012 selected a first-order model).
Not reported in the frozen evidence package.
Reduced tumor burden in melanoma-bearing mice; cationic NLC highest antimelanoma efficacy (Chen 2012).
Precipitation was not reported. Extended storage or dilution of a poorly-soluble drug may result in precipitation; exact timing was not reported.
Aggregation was not reported; may occur under unfavorable conditions - exact timing not reported.

panels.event: B1 intracellular degradation / metabolism / extravasation / ECM traversal
panels.note: Not reported; not animated.

panels.event: B2 ER targeting / ER stress / ICD signaling
panels.note: ER localization, ER stress, and CRT/HMGB1/ATP release with DC maturation and CD8+ activation are supported at abstract level (Wang 2025). Shown qualitatively; no timing or quantities were reported.

panels.event: B2 size / zeta / EE / release / PK
panels.note: Not reported (article-page/abstract level). No numeric labels or deterministic timing are shown.
Systemic transport is shown for orientation only; pharmacokinetics and biodistribution were not reported.
Aqueous solubility increased 30-fold after SBE-betaCD complexation vs intrinsic solubility (Shukla 2020). Celastrol is BCS class IV.
Celastrol stability greatly increased in PBS (pH 7.4) and in rat and human plasma upon SBE-betaCD complexation (Shukla 2020).
Improved permeability across an EpiIntestinal 3D small-intestine tissue model (Shukla 2020).
This is a molecular inclusion complex, not a nanoparticle; no particle size/morphology/growth is animated.
A general nanomedicine expectation; no circulation/PK evidence exists for any Profile-B preset. Shown as a note, not an animation.
Not evidenced within Profile B; not animated.
Identified in a review (Sun 2024); primaries not opened. Shown only in a research-candidates panel with DOI.

placement_rules.persistent_badge: each active scene shows the badge of its most-load-bearing event
placement_rules.hover_detail: hovering any animated element reveals its note + citation
placement_rules.unsupported_tray: a collapsible 'What is NOT shown and why' tray lists all DO_NOT_ANIMATE + HYPOTHESIZED items for the current preset
placement_rules.citation_link: each note links to data/profile-b-evidence-package.json source id
